layman_headline: SOL is closing in on its profit target while XRP needs more time — no new trades yet.
layman_explanation: The crypto market just had a massive rally week — Bitcoin is up 23%, and most altcoins surged even harder. Our Solana position is up 8.4% and approaching our $100 exit target. XRP is slightly underwater at -3.8% but well above its stop-loss. Everything on the watchlist has already run 25-78% in a week, making new entries risky right now. We're better off managing what we have than chasing pumps.
layman_action: Hold current positions. Let SOL ride toward $100 and monitor XRP for continued recovery. Avoid opening new positions into this extended rally — wait for a pullback to get better entries.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates have already moved 25-78% in the past 7 days, making fresh entries extremely risky from a mean-reversion standpoint. TRUMP and XRP show low RSIs (29-31) despite huge weekly gains, suggesting a violent bounce from deeply oversold levels that may now pause. PUMP is overbought at RSI 75. The Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) with improving trend suggests momentum could continue short-term, but high BTC dominance at 58.7% warns that alt rallies may be borrowed time. SOL at $94.55 is within striking distance of our $100 target — the prudent move is to let winners run and wait for post-rally consolidation before deploying new capital.
risk_factors: Market is in Greed territory after a massive weekly rally — sharp correction risk is elevated for all positions
BTC dominance at 58.7% means capital could rotate back to BTC, dragging alts down disproportionately
XRP position is underwater and could deteriorate if the rally stalls, though stop-loss at $1.30 provides protection
watch_list: SOL price action near $95-100 resistance zone — be ready to take profit at target
XRP momentum — needs to reclaim $1.56 entry price; watch for weakness below $1.40
BTC holding $77K support — a breakdown here would drag all alts significantly lower
market_context: The crypto market is experiencing a powerful squeeze-led rally with BTC up 23% weekly and alts surging 25-78%. Fear & Greed has shifted from neutral (51 weekly avg) to Greed (71), but the speed of the move increases short-term correction risk.
context_banner: Massive squeeze rally has extended most assets — manage existing winners and wait for pullbacks before new entries.
